### CVE-2022-3972 — Pingkon HMS-PHP adminlogin.php sql injection
- Assigner: VulDB | Published: 2022-11-13 | Updated: 2025-04-14 | Max CVSS: 7.3
- CWE: CWE-707 CWE-707 Improper Neutralization -> CWE-74 Injection -> CWE-89 SQL Injection
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.3 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A vulnerability was found in Pingkon HMS-PHP. It has been rated as critical. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file admin/adminlogin.php. The manipulation of the argument uname/pass leads to sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The associated identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-213551.

Affected:
- Pingkon / HMS-PHP: affected n/a

References:
- https://github.com/Pingkon/HMS-PHP/issues/1
- https://vuldb.com/?id.213551

### CVE-2022-25866 — Command Injection
- Assigner: snyk | Published: 2022-04-25 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: Command Injection
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H/E:P`

The package czproject/git-php before 4.0.3 are vulnerable to Command Injection via git argument injection. When calling the isRemoteUrlReadable($url, array $refs = NULL) function, both the url and refs parameters are passed to the git ls-remote subcommand in a way that additional flags can be set. The additional flags can be used to perform a command injection.

Affected:
- n/a / czproject/git-php: affected unspecified <4.0.3 (custom)

Credits: Alessio Della Libera of Snyk Research Team

References:
- https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PHP-CZPROJECTGITPHP-2421349 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/czproject/git-php/commit/5e82d5479da5f16d37a915de4ec55e1ac78de733 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/czproject/git-php/releases/tag/v4.0.3 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2022-29221 — PHP Code Injection by malicious block or filename in Smarty
- Assigner: GitHub_M | Published: 2022-05-24 | Updated: 2025-04-23 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-94 CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Smarty is a template engine for PHP, facilitating the separation of presentation (HTML/CSS) from application logic. Prior to versions 3.1.45 and 4.1.1, template authors could inject php code by choosing a malicious {block} name or {include} file name. Sites that cannot fully trust template authors should upgrade to versions 3.1.45 or 4.1.1 to receive a patch for this issue. There are currently no known workarounds.

Affected:
- smarty-php / smarty: affected < 3.1.45; affected >= 4.0.0, < 4.1.1

References:

### CVE-2022-31625 — Freeing unallocated memory in php_pgsql_free_params()
- Assigner: php | Published: 2022-06-16 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-590 CWE-590 Free of Memory not on the Heap; CWE-824 CWE-824 Access of Uninitialized Pointer
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

In PHP versions 7.4.x below 7.4.30, 8.0.x below 8.0.20, and 8.1.x below 8.1.7, when using Postgres database extension, supplying invalid parameters to the parametrized query may lead to PHP attempting to free memory using uninitialized data as pointers. This could lead to RCE vulnerability or denial of service.

Affected:
- PHP Group / PHP: affected 7.4.X <7.4.30 (custom); affected 8.0.X <8.0.20 (custom); affected 8.1.X <8.1.7 (custom)

Credits: c dot fol at ambionics dot io

### CVE-2022-31626 — mysqlnd/pdo password buffer overflow
- Assigner: php | Published: 2022-06-16 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-120 CWE-120 Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

In PHP versions 7.4.x below 7.4.30, 8.0.x below 8.0.20, and 8.1.x below 8.1.7, when pdo_mysql extension with mysqlnd driver, if the third party is allowed to supply host to connect to and the password for the connection, password of excessive length can trigger a buffer overflow in PHP, which can lead to a remote code execution vulnerability.

Affected:
- PHP Group / PHP: affected 7.4.X <7.4.30 (custom); affected 8.0.X <8.0.20 (custom); affected 8.1.X <8.1.7 (custom)

### CVE-2022-31627 — Heap buffer overflow in finfo_buffer
- Assigner: php | Published: 2022-07-28 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 7.7
- CWE: CWE-590 CWE-590 Free of Memory not on the Heap
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:L`

In PHP versions 8.1.x below 8.1.8, when fileinfo functions, such as finfo_buffer, due to incorrect patch applied to the third party code from libmagic, incorrect function may be used to free allocated memory, which may lead to heap corruption.

Affected:
- PHP Group / PHP: affected 8.1.X <8.1.8 (custom)

Credits: reported by xd4rker at gmail dot com

References:

### CVE-2022-31631 — PDO::quote() may return unquoted string
- Assigner: php | Published: 2025-02-12 | Updated: 2025-02-13 | Max CVSS: 9.1
- CWE: CWE-74 CWE-74 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

In PHP versions 8.0.* before 8.0.27, 8.1.* before 8.1.15, 8.2.* before 8.2.2 when using PDO::quote() function to quote user-supplied data for SQLite, supplying an overly long string may cause the driver to incorrectly quote the data, which may further lead to SQL injection vulnerabilities.

Affected:
- PHP Group / PHP: affected 8.0.x <8.0.27 (semver); affected 8.1.x <8.1.15 (semver); affected 8.2.x <8.2.2 (semver)

References:
- https://bugs.php.net/bug.php?id=81740
- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20230223-0007/
